subject: general
question:
Match the following, according to lettering and numbering (uppercase lettering) as per BIS SP: 46-2003.

 
 

 **Width (W)**
 **Capital letters **
 
 

 (A) 5
 (I) W
 
 

 (B) 6
 (II) A, M, Q, V, X, Y
 
 

 (C) 7
 (III) B, D, G, H, K, N, O, P, R, S, T, U and Z
 
 

 (D) 9
 (IV) C, E, F, L
solution:
__**Explanation:**__

Here is the breakdown of the categories and their corresponding width values:

 
• **(I) W:** Corresponds to the width value **5**.
 
• **(II) A, M, Q, V, X, Y:** Corresponds to the width value **6**.
 
• **(III) B, D, G, H, K, N, O, P, R, S, T, U, Z:** Corresponds to the width value **7**.
 
• **(IV) C, E, F, L:** Corresponds to the width value **9**.

**Correct Option Analysis:**

The correct option is:

**Option 2:** A-(IV), B-(III), C-(II), D-(I)

Let’s verify this matching step-by-step:

 
• **A:** Refers to category **(IV)**, which includes letters **C, E, F, L** and corresponds to the width value **9**.
 
• **B:** Refers to category **(III)**, which includes letters **B, D, G, H, K, N, O, P, R, S, T, U, Z** and corresponds to the width value **7**.
 
• **C:** Refers to category **(II)**, which includes letters **A, M, Q, V, X, Y** and corresponds to the width value **6**.
 
• **D:** Refers to category **(I)**, which includes the letter **W** and corresponds to the width value **5**.

This matches the information provided in the question, confirming that **Option 2** is correct
